name: Media File Formatters
description: Display formatters for file media entities.
project_description: Media File Formatters (mff) adds two display formatters for core file fields. "Name field link text" (plugin mff_name_link_formatter) renders each file as a download link whose link text is the parent entity's label, with an optional open-in-new-window setting. "File field description text" (plugin mff_description_formatter) renders the file's per-item description, either as the link text of a file link or as standalone processed text with no link at all -- useful in Views when you want to show a file field's description rather than add a new field. Both formulate their output through core's file_link theme and getEntitiesToView(), so core file access and display flags are honored. The module ships no routes, permissions, services, or Drush commands; it only changes how an existing file field is displayed.
